g.text: Arduino button wiring — pins used by your sketch
Each button joins its signal pin to GND only while pressed.
Use normally open momentary push buttons.
Shown with two electrical contacts per button. Put one contact on each side of the center gap.
For 4-leg buttons: use two contacts that connect ONLY when pressed; check with a continuity tester.
Unplug USB/power before wiring. No 5V connection or external resistors: the code uses INPUT_PULLUP.
